notes: Headline: through llama-server's per-request path, an adapter-sized shift reached every request in both runs: 84 of 84 adapter requests and 36 of 36 W0 requests classified correctly by log-probability margin in run 1 (gap 0.64 logits), and 84 of 84 and 36 of 36 in run 2 (gap 0.69). SCOPE: on this prompt the margin sees the formal-verification adapter only (fv alone -0.131, adapter side; corpus alone -0.925, design alone -0.534, corpus+design -0.634, all W0 side). The test does not show that all three adapters were applied. 33 of the 84 adapter requests in run 1 and 16 of 84 in run 2 still chose the W0-like token. The greedy-text gate fails (7 of 24) because it is not measuring adapter application.

Why text fails: at the second generated token the base model prefers <think> over ``` by 0.82 logits through the server. The three adapters move that margin by +0.90, leaving +0.078, a near tie. Decoding the same tokens in a different batch composition moves logits by up to 0.46 (0.0 when the composition is identical), so requests take either branch.

Order of events, from the run stamps (UTC): (1) library probe 23:06:46-23:21:30; (2) strict text re-run on the server 23:36:02-23:37:01, the run whose VRAM and slot figures are gated here; (3) server-level log-probability test run 1 00:11:56-00:12:35; (4) server-level log-probability test run 2 00:50:57-00:51:12, which adds the per-adapter-subset references and distinct-margin counts. This packet joins them; they were not one experiment.

The mixed rounds add nothing about noise: the server never batches different adapter configurations together, so those 24 results equal the two single-request references exactly (run 2 records this). The effective sample is 34 distinct adapter margins and 14 distinct W0 margins, not 84 and 36 independent draws.

The strict text re-run overlapped a CPU job on the same machine: 22.5 tok/s per slot against 36.3 in the first smoke run, and the server took 18.49 s to load against 3.05 s. Throughput from this run should not be used.

Agreement and disagreement between runs. Rounds 0 and 1 of the text re-run show slots 0,1,2,6,7 W0-like, exactly the rows the library's 8-sequence 55+4 emulation predicts. Round 2 shows 7 of 8 after three arrival waves, which no library emulation reproduces; the staggered rounds of the server-level test use that arrival pattern and classify 24 of 24 correctly. The library's reconstruction of the first run's mixed batch predicts one W0-like row where that run showed two. Batch composition is not logged by the server, so it is inferred from arrival times and source.
'W0-like' means the first 60 characters match. In full, 0 of the 24 three-adapter outputs equal any W0 output.

Cause of the composition dependence, part measured and part open. In the pinned source the CUDA backend quantises the activation operand of quantised-weight matmuls to 8 bits per block of 32 (mmvq.cu:1562, mmq.cu:291, quantize.cu:89-90) and picks the kernel by batch row count. Measured for six matmuls (ffn_up, ffn_gate and ffn_down of blk.28 and blk.31): emulating that quantisation reproduces the runtime to 1e-05-1.1e-04 where exact arithmetic differs by 3e-03-9e-03. That this is what makes logits depend on batch composition is an inference; there is no unquantised control.

The mechanism is incomplete (round-2 correction): eight identical sequences in one batch still differ row to row (all8_whole: W0 fork margins span -1.038 to -0.802 across the 8 rows), which kernel choice by batch row count cannot explain, since all rows share one batch size. Treat the cause of batch-composition noise as open.

Consequence for gates elsewhere: test adapter application, T-C5 rollback and 'adapter changes output' on log-probabilities under a fixed batch composition, not on greedy text. Packet 002's 8-slot 'triple LoRA' throughput figures stand as throughput and carry no evidence about per-slot content either way.
overall_passed below is computed over all eight gates and is false, because the 8-slot text gate fails. workload.gate_views gives the other view and says who drew the line.
VRAM: only the 8 full-attention layers of this hybrid model hold K/V, which gives exactly 2048.0 MiB at 8 x 8192. The 773 MiB residual is not modelled.

llama.cpp b12549-8af68d486 cu12.4 Windows release, Qwen3.5-4B-Q8_0.gguf sha256 10cc391b...61e1, mcproof composition LoRAs (each a single rank-8 pair on blk.31.ffn_up). Server flags: -c 65536 -np 8 -ngl 99 -ctk f16 -ctv f16 --slots --no-cache-idle-slots --lora-scaled with the three adapters at scale 0.0, --lora-init-without-apply, --host 127.0.0.1. Native Windows 11, before WSL.

Runs were launched through mlos gpu-lease and mlos stamp-run. The embedded stamp is from the strict text re-run; no separate lease record is embedded. Raw server logs contain a local path and are not shipped; their hashes are listed.

History: the first smoke run (16:39) showed slots 2 and 3 returning W0-like text; the swarm's verifier caught it and the receipt was held. A source review of the server at this commit found no path by which an equal-config batch could skip the adapter set, with medium-high confidence and without reading all of it. The log-probability test above is the direct check.

Embedded-data notes: 127.0.0.1 and the ephemeral ports in the raw records are loopback-only server endpoints, not network exposure. The harness label w0_identical means the first 60 characters match a W0 output, not full equality; full-content hashes are reported separately.

Review: recomputed from raw files by two independent reviewers (rounds 1 and 2); every number reproduced. Round 2 found that the margin sees the formal-verification adapter only, that the mixed rounds are serialised, and that the noise mechanism is incomplete; those corrections are applied in this revision. The round-2 fixes were applied by the author; a third, narrow review of the revision is recorded in receipts/REVIEW_ROUND_3.md.
